scope: Historical collection evidence; no raw run, process counter, source manifest or binary hash is modified by this qualification.
display_isolation: Collectors used Xvfb -displayfd without proving that the selected X11 listener was owned by the spawned Xvfb process. The smaps report records :0. A subsequent isolation investigation showed that display-number allocation alone can conflict with an existing native Xwayland endpoint; these historical reports cannot retrospectively prove which listener accepted their clients.
server_attribution: Recorded Xvfb RSS/PSS and per-window graphical counters remain raw observations, but attribution to the server rendering these application windows and cross-terminal server-cost comparability are not proven.
interpretation: Application PID/start-time memory samples remain historical observations on this busy host. Claims of an isolated display, fair graphical-resource attribution or a verified total system-memory comparison are provisional until guarded reruns.
required_rerun_guard: tools/isolated_xvfb.py checks display leases, pathname and abstract UNIX endpoints, the spawned PID lock and its listener ownership before clients connect.
